👋 Direct issue creation is restricted to project maintainers in **ERBoard**.

We use **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/kalandkar/erboard/discussions)** as our triage front door:
- **Bug Reports:** Open a discussion in **Issue Triage**. Once confirmed and reproducible, a maintainer will convert your discussion directly into an Issue.
- **Feature Proposals:** Start a discussion in **Feature Requests, Ideas**.
- **ERBoard Self-Audits:** Share `erboard review` runs on this repository in **Self-Audits & Benchmarks**.

For full details, please read our [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/kalandkar/erboard/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI Usage Policy](https://github.com/kalandkar/erboard/blob/main/AI_POLICY.md).
